title: Gibson '47 Brand Flagship Wash MVP Hat

long_description.body:
This stylish Gibson Classic Black '47 Flagship Wash MVP Hat has a structured crown, a curved visor, and an adjustable snapback. The front has a raised embroidered Gibson logo. Made from comfortable garment-washed cotton twill and soft mesh, it will quickly become your favorite hat.





Adjustable snapback




One size fits most




Cotton twill and soft mesh construction




Embroidered GIbson and '47 brand logos
